trial_court: Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sopore (CRM(M) No.06/2021)
case_name: Hilal Ahmad Lone vs Gulshana Begum
facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent are husband and wife who contracted their marriage in 2017. Petitioner claims to have divorced respondent by executing a written divorce deed on May 29, 2019, which was sent to the respondent through registered post. Respondent filed an application under Section 488 Cr. P. C seeking monthly maintenance of Rs.20,000.

legal_principles.principle: At the stage of grant of interim maintenance, the Court is only supposed to look to the admitted factual position and not embark upon determination of disputed questions of fact.
legal_principles.held: The trial court has correctly ignored the plea of divorce taken by the petitioner and granted maintenance of Rs.8000/ per month to the wife.
cited_cases: Savitri v. Govind Singh Rawat, (1985) 4 SCC 337
Rajnesh v. Neha and another, Cr. Appeal No.730 of 2020

legal_principles.principle: Proceedings before the Magistrate are summary in nature and the complicated disputed questions like the factum of marriage or divorce cannot be made subject matter of adjudication in these proceedings.
legal_principles.held: The provision is intended to provide a quick remedy to provide succour to destitute wife.
cited_cases: Savitri v. Govind Singh Rawat, (1985) 4 SCC 337
Rajnesh v. Neha and another, Cr. Appeal No.730 of 2020

outcome.final_order: The final court order quashed the orders passed by the trial court and the Revisional Court.

keywords: High Court of Jammu and Kashmir
